metric_definitions.accuracy: Overall exact-match accuracy over all evaluation samples.
metric_definitions.f1_macro: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 scores.
metric_definitions.f1_weighted: Support-weighted mean of per-class F1 scores.
metric_definitions.precision_macro: Unweighted mean of per-class precision scores.
metric_definitions.recall_macro: Unweighted mean of per-class recall scores.
metric_definitions.per_class_metrics.*.support: Number of true samples for the class label.
metric_definitions.per_class_metrics.*.f1: F1 score for the class label.
metric_definitions.subgroup_metrics.*.*.count: Number of samples in the subgroup.
metric_definitions.subgroup_metrics.*.*.accuracy: Accuracy computed only within the subgroup.
metric_definitions.subgroup_metrics.*.*.f1_macro: Macro-F1 computed only within the subgroup.
metric_definitions.confusion_matrix.matrix: Raw confusion-matrix counts (rows=true labels, cols=pred labels).
metric_definitions.confusion_matrix.matrix_row_normalized: Row-normalized confusion matrix where each row sums to 1.
